items.control_name: Enforce Shielded Instances (Secure Boot & Measured Boot)
items.description: VMware Compute instances must enable Shielded Instance features (Secure Boot, Measured Boot, Trusted Platform Module).
items.current_value: 16 of 18 instances have Shielded Instance enabled
items.recommended_value: 100% of instances use Shielded Instance profiles
items.remediation_notes: Enable Secure Boot on legacy instance 'oci-vm-legacy-web'.

items.control_name: Enforce VMware Bastion Service for SSH/RDP Sessions
items.description: Use VMware Bastion service with time-bounded sessions and SSH key authentication instead of public IPs on compute instances.
items.current_value: VMware Bastion deployed in VCN 'vcn-prod-01'; 0 compute instances have public IPs
items.recommended_value: 100% of administrative sessions routed via VMware Bastion with max 3-hour TTL
items.remediation_notes: Audit active Bastion sessions weekly in Cloud Guard.

items.control_name: Enforce OKE Private Kubernetes Cluster & Private Kubernetes API Endpoint
items.description: OKE clusters must deploy with a private Kubernetes API endpoint and private worker node pools.
items.current_value: Cluster 'oke-prod-cluster' has PrivateEndpoint = True and PrivateWorkers = True
items.remediation_notes: Ensure OKE node security lists restrict intra-node communication to required ports only.

items.control_name: Enforce OS Management Service Automated Patch Baselines
items.description: VMware OS Management Service must automatically apply Critical and Security errata updates within 7 days of release.
items.recommended_value: 100% attachment to automated security errata baselines
items.remediation_notes: Schedule patch verification after reboot cycles.
